title: Welcome home
caption:
Welcome to Leaf People. 🌿

Forget the inbox, the traffic, the noise. For the next sixty seconds you're somewhere else — a Colombian cloud forest, ankle-deep in leaf litter, the air thick and green.

This is an app, and a world, built around one thing: the rarest rainforest plants on earth.

Stay a while. leafpeople.app
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Breathe in
caption:
Breathe in.

Wet earth, crushed leaves, something sweet flowering far overhead. The rainforest floor doesn't smell like anything you keep in a pot — it smells alive.

We can't bottle it. But we can bring you the plants that grow in it. Every single day.

🌿 leafpeople.app
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Meet the Queen
caption:
Meet the Queen. 👑

Anthurium warocqueanum — three feet of black-green velvet hung from a rainforest tree, one of the most coveted plants on the planet.

Most people will never see one in person. Here, she's only the beginning.

leafpeople.app
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: What is Leaf People
caption:
So what is Leaf People?

A field guide, a care tracker, an ID engine and a collector's marketplace — built only for rare rainforest plants. Not ten thousand species skimmed. The ones actually worth knowing, studied deep.

By plant people, for plant people. leafpeople.app 🌿
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Find the light
caption:
Find the light.

On the forest floor it arrives in pieces — a shaft here, a glow there, filtered through a hundred feet of canopy. It's why these leaves grow so big, so dark, so hungry.

Slow down. Let your eyes adjust. There's a whole world down here.

🌿 #leafpeople
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Blackest leaf
caption:
The blackest leaf in the room.

Anthurium 'Ace of Spades' drinks the light — velvet so dark it reads almost black, with an oil-slick shimmer when it turns.

Some plants are pretty. This one is a statement.

leafpeople.app 🖤
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Why we built it
caption:
Why we built Leaf People.

Because if you've ever fallen down a 1am rabbit hole trying to tell two velvet anthuriums apart, you know the tools out there weren't made for us.

So we made our own. Identify, track, learn, collect — all in one place.

🌿 leafpeople.app
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Rain on leaves
caption:
The sound of rain on leaves.

Not the city kind — the jungle kind. Fat drops drumming on giant foliage, running down a leaf the size of your arm, feeding roots that never go thirsty.

Close your eyes. You're there.

🌿 #rainforest #leafpeople
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Silver lightning
caption:
Silver lightning.

Those veins on Anthurium crystallinum aren't painted — it's the way the velvet scatters light. Sugar-white over deep forest green.

Nature engineered this. We just can't stop staring.

leafpeople.app ✨
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Deep not wide
caption:
We went deep, not wide.

Anyone can list ten thousand plants. We chose a handful of genera — the rare rainforest aroids and their cousins — and learned them properly. Light, humidity, substrate, the lot.

Quality over quantity. Always.

🌿 leafpeople.app
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Morning mist
caption:
Morning mist.

For an hour after dawn the cloud forest disappears into white — every leaf beaded with water, the whole world hushed and dripping.

This is the calm we're chasing. A pocket of jungle, two feet from your couch.

🌿 #leafpeople #calm
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: The deep end
caption:
The ones collectors whisper about.

Anthurium papillilaminum — deep, suede-dark, impossibly velvet. The kind of plant that starts bidding wars and long flights to nurseries you've never heard of.

This is the deep end. Welcome.

🌿 leafpeople.app
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: You're not the only one
caption:
You're not the only one. 🌿

There's a whole community of people who love these plants like family — who name them, photograph them, mourn a lost leaf.

Leaf People is home base for all of us. Pull up a chair.

cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Your pocket of jungle
caption:
Your own pocket of jungle.

You don't need a greenhouse or a plane ticket. One rare leaf on a shelf, catching the morning light, is enough to take your whole mind somewhere greener.

That's the magic. That's why we're here.

🌿 #leafpeople #biophilia
cta: Welcome to Leaf People — follow @leafpeople.app and we'll take you to the jungle every day.

title: Welcome home (bridge)
caption:
If you've made it this far — welcome home. 🌿

Leaf People is your daily escape to the rainforest, plus the tools to bring a piece of it home: identify any rare aroid, track its care, learn from a real field guide, trade with collectors.

Hit follow. Tomorrow we go deeper — the rarest, strangest, most beautiful leaves on earth.

title: Cutucuense — the drape
caption:
Velvet that drapes.

Anthurium cutucuense unrolls long, rippling, suede-dark leaves that hang like fabric from the stem. The texture stops people mid-sentence — you don't display this plant, you introduce it.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Siltepecana — silver
caption:
Silver in the shade.

Monstera siltepecana climbs the understory in dusty, blue-silver leaves, fenestrating as it matures. A little piece of the canopy's edge, on your wall.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Callistophylla — stained glass
caption:
Stained glass.

The veins on Hoya callistophylla are pressed into the leaf like dark leading in stained glass — a map you could trace for hours. Texture is the whole event.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Thai Constellation
caption:
Painted by chance.

Monstera 'Thai Constellation' is splattered with creamy variegation no two plants share — stable, slow, and coveted. A galaxy on a leaf, priced like one.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: The hunt
caption:
The hunt is half the fun.

Learning to read a petiole, a cataphyll, a new leaf unfurling — the skills that turn a buyer into a grower. Nobody's born knowing this. You pick it up, one plant at a time.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Vittariifolium — the ribbon
caption:
The ribbon.

Anthurium vittariifolium drops pendant, strap-thin leaves up to a metre long — a living green curtain. Strange, elegant, unmistakably rare.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Squamiferum — fuzzy petioles
caption:
Look at that stem.

Philodendron squamiferum grows fuzzy, red-bristled petioles you'll want to touch, holding up oak-leaf foliage. Half the beauty of an aroid is the parts that aren't the leaf.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Forgetii — bone-white rim
caption:
Bone-white, edge to edge.

Anthurium forgetii rounds its dark leaves into near-perfect ovals, rimmed and veined in pale bone-white. No lobes, no drama — just a clean, gleaming disc.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: White Knight
caption:
Half-and-half.

Philodendron 'White Knight' throws near-black stems against crisp white-variegated leaves. High contrast, high demand, slow to climb — the collector's tax.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: First rare plant
caption:
Remember your first 'real' rare plant?

The one you saved for, tracked down, unboxed with your heart in your throat — then checked on six times a day for a week.

Drop it in the comments. 👇
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Wendlingeri — pendant velvet
caption:
Velvet, but make it alive.

Anthurium wendlingeri hangs in long, quilted, light-eating ribbons — matte enough to read as shadow. Feels like suede, photographs like a void. No filter.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Tortum — living sculpture
caption:
Almost not there.

Philodendron tortum splits its leaves into thin, twisting, skeletal fingers — more sculpture than foliage. The jungle's idea of minimalism.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Corrugatum — quilted
caption:
Quilted.

Anthurium corrugatum puckers between every vein — a three-dimensional, bullate surface that catches light in a dozen directions at once. Run your eyes over it slowly.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Pink Princess
caption:
The variegation lottery.

Philodendron 'Pink Princess' can throw a leaf of pure bubblegum pink — or revert to plain green and break your heart. You can't farm luck. That's why collectors chase it.
cta: Follow @leafpeople.app for the rarest plants on earth, daily.

title: Morona — the bridge
caption:
If you've made it this far, you're one of us. 🌿

There's a whole world of rare aroids — and almost nothing built for the people who love them. So we built it. Leaf People: identify to the species, track care, learn from a real field guide, trade with collectors. All at leafpeople.app.
